angle.hook: the Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Collector's Edition sold out immediately, Embracer says
angle.why_now: Embracer's Q2 report of 11 Nov is the first company statement on how pre-orders are going, three months before the 12 Feb 2027 launch
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players can pre-order on Steam now; Embracer gave no pre-order numbers and the mainstream campaign with Amazon Games starts in December
angle.payoff: teaser over 7 million organic views in under a week, pre-orders and wishlists above target
